fields.title: Build a Cost Model
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Bill: compute 400k, storage 120k, traffic 90k, analytics 60k, SMS 180k, acquiring 620k. Audience is planned to double with behavior remaining the same.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: What drivers are items tied to?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: compute, traffic, analytics, SMS, acquiring — tied to active users and transactions, double in proportion. Storage — tied to accumulated volume, grows faster than double, approximately 2.3 times. Bill: approximately 2.9 million instead of 1.47 million. Acquiring requires attention — the largest item, linear, does not decrease with scale; it is a negotiation lever, and one should start before growth, not after.
